svg.title: Exposure and provisional ASA — 15.5 mm cardstock trial labels
svg.desc: Two 15.5 mm nominal cut circles, no center holes or kerf compensation. Exposure markings are reciprocal seconds: 1000, 500, 250, 125, 60, 30, 15, 8, 4, 2. ASA markings: 100, 200, 400, 800, corresponding provisionally to 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x analog gain, not calibrated sensitivity. Both rotating labels select increasing values when turned counterclockwise against a stationary body index. The exposure caption is a centered stacked fraction: SEC above a horizontal rule, X below. X denotes the selected scale number: exposure time is one second divided by X. ASA is centered. No ticks; only ASA has sector dividers. Black filled outlines engrave first; red circles cut last. Import at 100% scale; overall canvas is 43 by 21.5 mm. No laser power, speed or machine commands are supplied.
